perfil.resumo: Explainer/curiosity shorts: one surprising thing explained (why the scythe became the symbol of death, the concrete shape that stops waves, the saw that stops on a finger) over a FAST collage of real videos — about 16 different sources in a 40 s short (one new source every ~2.6 s; 2 cuts in a row inside the same source are normal and sources come back). Signature: an animated red ARROW pointing at the object in the first second, one-word white bold lowercase captions in the lower third, slow zooms, a white flash when the topic turns, horizontal videos placed in the middle with the same video blurred behind, soft background music the whole time and a sound only where something happens.

ritmo.cortes: a cut on almost every sentence or idea; one new video about every 2-3 s; another moment of the same video in the next cut is fine; a source can come back later

gancho.descricao: a surprising question or claim about the object on screen, with the red arrow pointing at it in the first second
exemplos: Why did a farmer's tool become the symbol of death?
This weird concrete shape stops the most powerful waves on Earth.
This saw stops the moment it touches your finger.

estrutura.descricao: surprising question/claim + red arrow on the object
what it looks like / what people believe
the explanation, step by step, each sentence over a video that shows it
the most surprising detail (a number, a hidden mechanism, the twist)
one last curious fact or a question for the comments

perfil.tom: curious, clear and fast; fascinated by the detail; never condescending
perfil.linguagem: short spoken sentences, simple words, concrete numbers

composicoes.descricao: a piece of one of the creator's videos that shows exactly the sentence (horizontal videos in the middle, blurred copy behind)
stock footage when no source shows it
an epic AI image for what cannot be filmed (the reaper, an angel, a historical scene)
a realistic generated ~8 s video when motion is the point
composicoes.quando: 1 in 3 shots at most, when there are no sources

textos_tela.descricao: no big text: the one-word caption does the job

sfx.descricao: sound in only ~25-45% of the cuts, where something happens (whoosh on a fast move, impact on a crash, pop when the arrow appears, boom on the reveal)

musica.descricao: soft curious/epic background track, low, the whole video

exemplos: Why is the reaper holding a scythe?
The concrete shape that defeats the ocean
The saw that refuses to cut you

evitar: a shot that does not show what the sentence says
staying more than ~4 s on the same shot

metricas.obs: medido em 4 shorts explicativos (8 q/s nos cortes, cada corte conferido quadro a quadro: ~20% dos cortes ficam no mesmo vídeo, ~10% dos planos voltam a uma fonte); os 3 de comentário foram descartados
